svg.title: C19-M05-F2: Narrow trust + detect the rest
svg.desc: Structural containment plus detection for lateral movement.
svg.text: C19-M05-F2 Narrow trust + detect the rest
STRUCTURAL : segmentation + tiering + credential hygiene -> fewer hops possible
DETECTION : unusual remote logon path ; orphan alternate-auth logon
=> block what you can; detect what remains
Figure C19-M05-F2. Containment narrows trust; detection covers the remaining hops [C19-M05-R4].
